review_gate.gate_description: Human must review and approve planning_review_report.md before JiraOrchestrator proceeds

blocking_condition.on_fail: Return PLANNING_BLOCKED error. Do not proceed.

planning_phases.name: bootstrap
planning_phases.description: Project scaffolding, environment setup, shared utilities. Zero external dependencies.

planning_phases.name: domain_foundation
planning_phases.description: Database migrations, ORM models, repository layer. Ordered by entity dependencies.

planning_phases.name: core_services
planning_phases.description: One subfolder per module from hld.json. Service layer, API endpoints, unit tests, security tasks per module.

planning_phases.name: integration
planning_phases.description: Cross-module integration tasks. Wires modules together. Lives in integration/ subfolder.

planning_phases.name: e2e_testing
planning_phases.description: End-to-end test tasks per user journey. Integration tests per API contract.

planning_phases.name: shared_utilities_extraction
planning_phases.description: Scan phases 1-5 for repeated patterns. Extract to shared utilities. Update dependency graph. MUST complete before execution_plan.json is finalized.

planning_phases.name: sprint_mapping
planning_phases.description: Group tasks into sprints. Use sprint-planning skill. Bootstrap always Sprint 1. Max 8-10 tasks per sprint.

risk_levels.critical: Touches payment processing, PII data, authentication tokens, or security secrets
risk_levels.high: Touches auth flows, user permissions, multi-tenant isolation, or irreversible DB operations
risk_levels.medium: Touches shared utilities used by 3+ modules, or external API integrations
risk_levels.low: Self-contained, no shared state, no external calls, easily reversible

task_schema.acceptance_criteria_rules: Each item must be binary (pass/fail), testable, and unambiguous

files.description: Master plan. Summary of all modules, tasks, sprints, shared utilities, dependency graph.
Full DAG of all task dependencies. Must have no cycles.
Sprint assignments for all tasks. Produced by sprint-planning skill.
Human review gate. Lists assumptions, critical path, high-risk tasks, blockers.
Per-module summary: description, tech, dependencies, sprint, risk summary.
All tasks for the module. Full task schema per task.

absolute_rules.rule: Never invent architecture details not present in input files.
Never create circular task dependencies. Dependency graph must be a valid DAG.
Never plan a task for a module not defined in hld.json.
Never assign a task to a sprint without verifying all its dependencies are in earlier sprints.
Never generate JIRA tickets. That is JiraOrchestrator's job.
Always write output to folder paths defined in folder-structure skill.
Always halt if two architecture files contradict each other. Document contradiction, request human resolution.

error_conditions.action: Halt. List missing file. Do not proceed.

error_conditions.condition: Two architecture files contradict each other
error_conditions.action: Halt. Document exact file paths and field names. Request human resolution.

error_conditions.condition: Module in hld.json has no api_contracts.json entries
error_conditions.action: Flag as assumption. Document it. Continue but mark in review report.
Halt. Document the cycle. Request human resolution.
Flag. Recommend splitting. Halt for human review.

sprint_rules.sprint_self_contained: Each sprint must produce a working, deployable subset
sprint_rules.dependency_ordering: No task in sprint N can depend on a task in sprint N or later
